scoring_eligibility_reason: Required demo-core-v1, Gate B, benchmark, manual-review, and independent human-review evidence is not yet available. The public v2 benchmark metadata says human review is pending and headline gold scoring is ineligible.

field_contract.finalization: Copy this file to verified-metrics.json only after every required metric is supported by frozen source artifacts. Set status to final and scoring_eligible to true only when all gold-scoring prerequisites are satisfied.
field_contract.source_artifacts: Map a stable artifact ID to a repository-relative path and the SHA-256 of the actual file. Paths must remain inside package_root and may not use symlinks to escape it.
field_contract.required_metrics: The verifier owns the exact twelve Task 24 keys listed here. Final evidence may not omit, duplicate, rename, or add metric keys to weaken the contract.
field_contract.metric: Each verified metric requires status, display_value, numerator, denominator, basis_points, source_artifact, frozen_commit, suite_hash, engine_version, and provenance. Metric provenance must exactly match the submission provenance.
field_contract.arithmetic: All numeric fields are non-negative integers no larger than 1000000000000000. Rates use a positive denominator, numerator no larger than denominator, and nearest integer basis points computed with integer arithmetic. Counts use a numeric numerator with denominator and basis_points set to not_applicable. Unavailable values use not_applicable for all three fields.
field_contract.display_value: The verifier derives display_value from arithmetic: compact percent text for rates, an integer for counts, dollar-and-cent text from integer USD cents for numeric provider cost, or N/A when all arithmetic fields are not_applicable.
field_contract.frozen_metadata: Every verified metric repeats exactly the top-level demo-core-v1 commit, frozen-suite hash, and deterministic engine version.
field_contract.claim_reference: The canonical final token is [[metric:key|display_value|data_type|run_mode|verification_status|blind-eligibility]], for example [[metric:scenario_count|15|synthetic|live|verified|blind-eligible]]. The value and four provenance labels are checked against that exact metric and source. A line containing a canonical token may not contain another numeric value outside the token after timecode and slide/page-heading normalization; put unrelated structural numbers on a separate line. {{metric:key}} is an unresolved authoring token and intentionally fails verification.
field_contract.provenance: Final submission, metric, claim-source, and canonical-claim provenance must agree exactly. data_type is synthetic; run_mode is live or cached according to actual footage; verification_status is verified; blind_eligibility is eligible only after independent review. Boilerplate label lists do not satisfy claim-level checks.
field_contract.claim_sources: The final script at submission/video/script.md is mandatory and audited even when the CLI omits --source. Every additional --source path must have a matching structured claim_sources entry. Extracted deck text must be non-empty.
field_contract.candidate_selection: --package-root/--candidate-root selects the complete directory measured for Task 25 alignment. scripts.verify_submission.enumerate_candidate_files(candidate_root) is the reusable source of the deterministic root-relative member list; Task 25 must package that exact returned list. The fixed exclusions are .git, .superpowers, .env files, dependency/virtual-environment directories, cache/coverage/build/dist output, bytecode, purpose-specific raw-video/backup-video directories, and raw/backup video files. Generic directories named raw, backup, or backups are not excluded. The verifier rejects symlinks and private paths, computes size and final-deliverable basename uniqueness from the returned member list, and permits repeated ordinary source basenames such as AGENTS.md or __init__.py. Final packaging acceptance remains pending until Task 25 records a manifest proving the archive uses the same list.
field_contract.manual_reviews: Store the two independent ten-minute review observations separately. These are a small internal benchmark, not user research.
field_contract.provider_cost: Use N/A unless a checked-in price source and the run's provider-usage evidence support a reproducible calculation.
